item.title: Invincible Officially Addresses Its Worst Season 4 Episode With Season 5 Reveal
item.description: Prime Video’s animated series Invincible has a tradition of announcing the release date for its new seasons with meta shorts showing Mark Grayson (Steven Yeun) chatting with another character in Burger Mart, the fast-food restaurant he worked at before becoming a superhero. The goofy self-referential sketches provide a short summary of the events of the previous season, while also acknowledging fan feedback, from how often Mark loses fights to the unfortunate break in the middle of season 3.

item.title: Parks and Rec's Spiritual Sequel Reveals a Dark Truth About Sitcoms and Streaming
item.description: So when Peacock announced a new comedy series from Parks and Rec creator Mike Schur and its star, Amy Poehler, my initial response was unbridled optimism. If anyone could prove the genre still works, it's the team behind one of the best sitcoms ever, right?

item.title: GTA 6's Free PC Competitor Is Blowing Up on Steam
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here — but only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, with PC gamers still waiting for Rockstar Games to officially announce a port of the game. While Grand Theft Auto 5 and GTA Online have been a hit on Steam, Rockstar seems to be in no hurry to bring GTA 6 to PC. Reportedly, though, that will happen sometime in 2027 .

item.title: The Game Awards’ Biggest GOTY Snub Has Been Officially Redeemed
item.description: This week, Geoff Keighley announced the nominees for the 2026 Game Awards . With only six games making the cut for Game of the Year, several major titles were inevitably left out. Pearl Abyss' massive RPG Crimson Desert was one of the biggest snubs , especially since it's already racking up wins at other events.

item.title: Surprising No One, GTA 6's Comedy Is All Over the Place
item.description: More than being deviously fun crime sandboxes, every Grand Theft Auto game also acts as a snapshot of American culture at the time of its release. These games have never pulled any punches, taking swings at everything from the paparazzi to politics to the most innocuous corners of pop culture. GTA 6 was sure to take the same shots, but at a time when the targets are moving faster than ever. Could a game that has been in the works for more than a decade possibly have humor that felt up to date? Would it be careful to punch up rather than turn the country’s most vulnerable people into punchlines? And would it have the stones to take on President Donald Trump, a man who has dominated America’s political culture throughout the game’s entire development cycle?

item.title: New Fallout Game Leaks and Is Puzzling Players
item.description: It’s been more than a decade since the last mainline single-player Fallout game, and fans are feverish for what’s next. While Fallout: New Vegas developer Obsidian has already announced that it is working on a new game, there’s no telling how long it will take for this untitled project to be released. If you're waiting for Fallout 5 , don't hold your breath. Bethesda likely won't begin serious work on the game until it finishes The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel . However, a leak from the Australian Classification Board reveals a bizarre new Fallout game in development.

item.title: 'Yellowjackets' Season 4 Review: A Chaotic Finale That Goes Out on Its Own Terms
item.description: Endings are hard. As a viewer, watching the final season of a show you love adds an extra weight to every beat. Is this moment a callback to a previous season? What will be the overall arc of a character I've been invested in for years?

item.title: Epic Games Store Officially Makes Highly Rated Soulslike Free for a Limited Time
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally out today around the globe. Unfortunately, it's only available on console at the moment, meaning plenty of gamers will have to wait until it arrives on PC . If you only have a PC and you're looking for something new to play, head over to the Epic Games Store. For a limited time, you can grab a great action-adventure game at no charge.

item.title: GTA 6 Brings Back a Legendary Rockstar Easter Egg
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has only been out for hours, but players have already started discovering plenty of hidden details, including strange side quests and callbacks to previous games. A lucky few are reporting sightings of a creature that needs to be seen to be believed: Bigfoot.

item.title: Is Charlie Vickers finally playing the real Sauron?
item.description: Vickers said the mask is off, but is this Sauron more real than any of the others?
